After that, I have a question now for you. Looking at this, at this field, I think everything is clear now for you. Considering the geometry, the topology, the axis to outside the field, the sun, sunshine during the year, probably wind, the climate, whatever the fuck, which I don't know right now. Where do you think the building of the house should be placed? We have a lot of places. Which where inside this whole area should that be, and why? What's the reason? And I really, really like to have a garden, a place for my kids to be able to play. Something, for example, when I look down the city, I would like to see big trees in front of me. When the wind comes, I love the sound of the trees. When it rains, it's really beautiful. And if we can make it level, not steps, or at least a few steps for the garden. I'm saying steps because, you know, it's on a slope. That would be absolutely perfect. But I don't know really, where do you think, considering all of this, like an expert, what do you suggest the house should be? How much should be the footprint? Should we build them on top of each other? Two floors or one floor? Where should the garage be? Consider the slope. The slope, I think, is a little bit too steep. So yeah, whatever answer you give me, if you can, please do it in Persian. But what you're recording the project, it would be nice if it would have been in English. So you can also talk to me in English, but I just prefer Persian. So yeah.

We're going to build a plan on this field of mine. First of all, you are Codex, so anything that you create, you then create it in a way that is recognizable. Because I am probably going to create... I'm not even sure if that's the best thing. Maybe you tell me, but I'm going to use Claude, Gemini, and Codex for this. And I think they are a bit different. Anyhow. So by looking at the field, you can see that it goes from west to east. East is downhill, and we want our house to look at east. But how the house is going to be oriented? It's going to be along the two borders, which go from west to east. Now if we do that, we're going to have a triangle left on the western side, where the southern part is, the wide part of it, and that's okay. We want to have our house in the north-west, or near north-west. We probably are going to leave some of the area on the western side for a, I don't know, a little arrival place which is open, like a little garden, but it's not a garden. I don't know what you call it in English, but in Persian it's called hayat. So find the equivalent for it. And then you enter there. There is a door. There's a door for the garage. You open it, the car goes in. And there's a door beside it. You open it. You're in a perimeter where you can then, with some stairs, go down to enter the house. And how I imagine this is the garage, and the garage is going to be on the road level. It's going to be the top floor of this house. Probably we're going to have a room there, like a home office or something. We're going to have possibly, not sure if it's the best place for the facilities, like a boiler, I don't know, water purifier, things like that, or electricity boxes. I'm not sure, but I think could be there. And then from there you can go down with the stairs or with the lift to the upper floor of this house. And yeah, then you can access the lower floor too beneath it. But then we need this to be, like, stepped: garage, then the lower floor beneath it. But this lower floor should be accessible from outside too. The entrance should be accessible from outside. So we can excavate as we want, as much as it is needed. There's no problem. We can excavate all the way, all we want. We can even excavate and reach United States of America from there. I have no restriction there. And we can build retaining walls. I also don't have any problem with that. So anyway, from the road, the house is not going to be built alongside the road. The house needs to be built alongside the field borders, which go from west to east or east to west in north and south. And as we enter our field, we're not going to enter the building. We're going to have a little bit of free space, which we're going to build a mosaic on it or whatever, or could be like concrete, whatever. Then with stairs, we can go to the entrance of the house, or we can go direct without stairs. We're going to go into the garage. Inside the garage is the lift, and probably inside stairs, which we can go, enter our house, and the same stair can go down to the lower floor. Now, that's what I imagine. And I want you to start building that. If you have questions, you can ask me. And also, don't build a house which feels like a prison with long hallways. That is just not what I want. I don't want to have a lot of hallways. Open areas are better, but well, entrance hallway, that's a different thing. We probably need that. But overall, don't try to make a prison for me, or a school for me, or a university, where we have a long hallway and then rooms everywhere, left and right. That's not what I want.
